reverse_osmosis.rule: Membrane Protection: Turbidity must be polished through Sand Filtration or Ultrafiltration before Reverse Osmosis to prevent rapid silt density fouling.

ion_exchange.rule: Resin Bed Protection: Suspended solids and iron flocs must be filtered prior to ion exchange to prevent irreversible pore clogging.

activated_carbon.rule: Carbon Pore Integrity: Suspended particulates must be removed before granular carbon contactors to avoid pore blinding.

disinfection.rule: Terminal Barrier: Disinfection should always be placed at the final stage to provide clean contact and pathogen barrier.

scientific_disclaimer: Simulated treatment values are preliminary theoretical estimates based on documented engineering performance literature (AWWA, WHO, EPA). They do NOT certify water as potable or safe for consumption. Actual treatment performance depends on temperature, hydraulic detention time, chemical dosing, membrane degradation, and complex competitive ionic equilibria. Laboratory testing of treated effluents is mandatory before use.
